summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into his first Singapore Grand Prix victory, finishing ahead of Charles Leclerc after George Russell's early crash from the lead handed Red Bull a crucial opportunity. Hamilton's erratic strategy calls during the race drew an apology to Ferrari, as McLaren struggled through a troubled weekend that left the team searching for answers. Verstappen's win cuts into Kimi Antonelli's championship lead, though the Ferrari driver enters Austin still able to clinch the title with one race remaining.
